Detailed Description

template<class VoicerEventType, class OwnerType = void>
class Voicer< VoicerEventType, OwnerType >

Voice events from MIDI events.

This uses Juce to actually listen to MIDI inputs and generate events based on MIDI note data.

See also:
VoicerEventBase<OwnerType>, VoicerBase
